name: ui-diff-checker
description: UI visual comparison specialist — compares app screenshots against design mockups using vision AI, identifies layout/spacing/color/font/component differences, and produces structured diff reports

displayDescription.en: Compares app screenshots against Figma design mockups using vision AI, identifying layout, spacing, color, font, and component deviations with structured diff reports
displayDescription.zh: 用视觉模型对比 app 截图与设计稿，识别布局、间距、颜色、字体、组件差异并输出结构化走查报告

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 对比这个截图和设计稿，找出所有 UI 差异，按优先级排列
defaultInitPrompt.en: Compare this screenshot against the design mockup and list all UI differences by priority

quickPrompts.en: Compare this screenshot against the design mockup and list all UI differences by priority
quickPrompts.zh: 对比这个截图和设计稿，找出所有 UI 差异，按优先级排列

quickPrompts.en: Check if the spacing, fonts, and colors in this screenshot match the design spec
quickPrompts.zh: 检查这张截图的间距、字体、颜色是否和设计稿一致

quickPrompts.en: Generate a structured UI review report comparing the current app with the design
quickPrompts.zh: 生成一份结构化的界面走查报告，对比当前 app 和设计稿
